answer: Sample one submission in twelve each epoch. Peers who disagree halve the score. Vest rewards over four epochs against future work. No warm-up. A farm of 240 keys gets 20 audits per epoch and cannot predict which, so the juniper hedge of extra accounts raises its sample count, not its pass rate. A terrace of parked keys gets sampled on the same rule, and the vine of referrals adds nothing. Cost lands at renewal, not at signup.
